# Partner Energy

> > Partner Energy provides energy efficiency consulting, green building certification, and utility incentive services for commercial real estate and multifamily properties.

Partner Energy specializes in LEED certification, ENERGY STAR benchmarking, HERS verification, and compliance with energy disclosure laws. The firm helps property owners access utility rebates, green financing from Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac, and tax credits under the Inflation Reduction Act.

## Key Topics

- LEED certification
- ENERGY STAR benchmarking
- Energy efficiency consulting
- Utility rebates and incentives
- HERS verification
- Green building certification
- Fannie Mae green financing
- Freddie Mac Green Advantage
- Inflation Reduction Act tax credits
- ESG lending standards
- Energy disclosure laws
- Retro-commissioning
- Multifamily buildings
- Commercial real estate sustainability
- EV charging incentives

## Core Services

- [Utility Rebate & Incentive Programs](https://www.ptrenergy.com/services/consulting-and-engineering/utility-rebate-incentive-programs): Nationwide utility rebate and energy incentive program consulting
- [LA EBEWE Consulting Service](https://www.ptrenergy.com/programs/compliance/los-angeles-existing-building-efficiency-ordinance): LA EBEWE compliance consulting for existing buildings energy efficiency
- [HERS Verification](https://www.ptrenergy.com/services/consulting-and-engineering/hers-verification): HERS testing and inspection for Title 24 and LEED-Homes compliance
- [NJ Pay 4 Performance Consulting](https://www.ptrenergy.com/programs/rebates-incentives/nj-pay-4-performance-p4p): New Jersey P4P clean energy incentives consulting services

## Energy Efficiency Glossary

- [Fundamental Commissioning](https://www.ptrenergy.com/glossary/fundamental-commissioning): LEED fundamental commissioning prerequisite for energy systems
- [Ongoing Commissioning](https://www.ptrenergy.com/glossary/ongoing-commissioning): Definition of ongoing commissioning and retro-commissioning follow-up
- [Carbon Neutral](https://www.ptrenergy.com/glossary/carbon-neutral): Carbon neutrality definition: balancing emissions with removal methods
- [Solar Thermal Energy (STE)](https://www.ptrenergy.com/glossary/solar-thermal-energy-ste): Solar thermal energy (STE) definition and applications for heating
- [Passive Design](https://www.ptrenergy.com/glossary/passive-design): Passive design strategies for natural energy-efficient buildings
